items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Billy directly; the interviewer mentions 'Billy and the Dee' and the interviewee only confirms 'In Pensacola' regarding Billy's maiden name (Goodson) without describing a personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: I think it was Thomas Valentine, the trumpet player. We had a drummer by the name of Lionel, I don't know what his last name is, man. The Creole name? No, I don't think so. Is he Lionel Thomas? I can't think of his name.
It might be the fellow who's working with Billy and the Dee, Bill, what's his last name? I forget it.
He used to work with an old time band around Reserve by the name of Dejon.
